name: @mashbean/tttc-serverless
description: Pocket TTTC (口袋議題樹): Talk to the City-style claim extraction and topic trees on a single Cloudflare Worker with Durable Objects and Workers AI — no server, no database, one-click deploy

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run deploy:dry

REPORT.description: One SQLite Durable Object per report: input rows, pipeline state, claims and the finished topic tree.

COORDINATOR.description: Durable Object holding the deployment-wide daily Workers AI neuron ledger and the report-creation rate limit.

AI.description: Workers AI binding (Gemma 4) used for clustering, claim extraction, grouping and summaries.
